name: Alivus Life Sciences Ltd
title: Alivus Life Sciences Ltd - 543322 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 6.4% to INR640 crores with GPL down 52.6%, offset by non-GPL growth of 26.5%; capacity deliberately paced with Solapur delayed to early Q3 and FY27 revenue guided at 10-12%.

utilisation.quote: we are already operating at probably 80%, 90% utilization or higher

capex.quote: There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

triggers.label: Solapur Phase 3 deferred, avoid under-absorption
triggers.quote: If we execute Phase 3 quickly, it will get us into a situation where we'll have a lot of under-absorption.

triggers.label: Non-GPL price decline 1-2%
triggers.quote: The price decline is about 1% to 2% is what we have seen.

triggers.label: GPL inventory rationalisation drives Q1 dip
triggers.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization.

triggers.label: Utilisation 80-90%+ per analyst
triggers.quote: we are already operating at probably 80%, 90% utilization or higher

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 10-12%, EBITDA 30-32%
triggers.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.
We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.
We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.
While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27

prior_guidance_check.metric: CDMO contracts closing early H2 FY27

red_flags.label: Solapur delay, Phase 1 now early Q3
red_flags.quote: There's a little bit of a delay

red_flags.label: Price decline in non-GPL
red_flags.quote: The price decline is about 1% to 2%

evasions.quote: So we don't want to hurry it up.
I can't put a number on it, Bhawana, okay?

summary.headline: Alivus Q1 FY27 revenue rose 6.4% YoY to INR640 crores as non-GPL grew 26.5%, offsetting a 52.6% GPL drop; EBITDA margin 36.6%.
